MINOR SWING - DJANGO REINHARDT

   There are only 3 chords you need to play this tune here they are :

[tab]          A minor 6                D minor 6                   E7
      e|-------------|          e|-------------|          e------------|
      B|--------5----|          B|------10-----|          B---5--------|
      G|--------5----|          G|------10-----|          G-------7----|
      D|------4------|          D|----9--------|          D-----6------|
      A|-------------|          A|-------------|          A-------7----|
      E|--------5----|          E|------10-----|          E------------|[/tab]

                           THE CHORD PATTERN

             [ch]Am6[/ch] / [ch]Dm6[/ch] / [ch]E7[/ch] / [ch]Am6[/ch] / [ch]Dm6[/ch] / [ch]Am6[/ch] / [ch]E7[/ch] / [ch]Am6[/ch] [ch]E7[/ch]

    This chord pattern is simply repeated, again and again, try using an
   [ch]E7#9[/ch] instead of [ch]E7[/ch] on the turnaround, just to make it more interesting.
